status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi courts sentenced three French ISIS members to life terms, while a separate court sentenced an MP over oil contracts, showing continued legal actions against militants and corruption. Security forces downed an unidentified drone over Baghdad and coordinated with the Kurdistan Region on weapons control, reflecting heightened air-space security. Prime Minister Al-Zaidi pressed Damascus on border security and oil links during a visit to Syria, linking regional diplomacy to Iraq's internal security agenda. Baghdad will host the 2028 OIC anti-corruption meeting, marking a new diplomatic role for the capital. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske domstoler dømte tre franske IS-medlemmer til livstid, mens en annen domstol dømte en stortingsrepresentant for oljeavtaler, noe som viser fortsatt rettslige tiltak mot militante og korrupsjon. Sikkerhetsstyrker skjøt ned en uidentifisert drone over Bagdad og koordinerte med Kurdistan-regionen om våpenkontroll, noe som reflekterer økt luftromssikkerhet. Statsminister Al-Zaidi presset Damaskus på grensesikkerhet og oljelenker under et besøk i Syria, og knyttet regional diplomati til Iraks interne sikkerhetsagenda. Bagdad vil være vertskap for OIC-møtet om antikorrupsjon i 2028, og markerer en ny diplomatisk rolle for hovedstaden. Konflikten førte til 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
